definition.def: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.
examples: He was saving his energy for next week's race in Belgium.
We try to boost our energy by eating.

definition.def: Energy is determination and enthusiasm about doing things. [approval]
examples: At 54 years old her energy and looks are magnificent.
You have drive and energy for those things you are interested in.

definition.def: Your energies are your efforts and attention, which you can direct towards a particular aim.
examples: She had started to devote her energies to teaching rather than performing.
We must concentrate our energies on treating addiction first.

definition.def: Energy is the power from sources such as electricity and coal that makes machines work or provides heat.
examples: Oil shortages have brought on an energy crisis.
It doesn't take much to improve the energy efficiency of your home.
